Rule.title: Default Credentials Must Be Changed
Rule.description: All default manufacturer credentials must be changed before deployment.

check.check-content: Verify default credentials have been changed.

Rule.fixtext: Change all default credentials to meet DoD password policy.

Rule.title: Management Interface Encryption Required
Rule.description: All management interfaces must use encrypted protocols (HTTPS, SSH).

check.check-content: Verify management interface uses TLS 1.2 or higher.

Rule.fixtext: Enable TLS 1.2+ on all management interfaces.

Rule.title: SNMP v3 Required
Rule.description: SNMP v1 and v2c are prohibited. Only SNMP v3 with authentication is allowed.
Rule.fixtext: Disable SNMP v1/v2c. Configure SNMP v3 with SHA authentication.
